text: I wake up at six-thirty every morning, even on weekends. After a quick shower, I make a simple breakfast of oatmeal and coffee while listening to the news. My work schedule is flexible, but I usually start at eight-thirty. I focus on my tasks for a few hours and take a short break mid-morning. Around five in the evening, I either go for a jog or do yoga at home. Exercise helps me clear my mind. After dinner, I read for thirty minutes or watch a documentary. I stick to this routine because it gives my day structure and reduces stress. Consistency makes me feel more productive and calm.
